title: Auth — Step-up Approver List — payload
description: List the live step-up approvers bound to one subject — the caller by default, or another subject within an administrator's authority. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

subject.description: Whose approvers to list. Absent means the caller. A subject other than the caller is answered only for an administrator whose standing covers it.

Response.title: Auth — Step-up Approver List — response payload
Response.description: Every live approver bound to the subject. Empty when the subject holds none.

approvers.description: The subject's live approvers — at most five, so the whole set is always returned.
